reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled since August (610→1260/month, E-02) because a majority of disputed bills (59%, 1785/3025, E-04) are issued on ACTUAL meter reads that are billed incorrectly, not because customer-service response handling is slow (response times remain within the 3.0-day SLA, median 1.6d/p90 2.8d, E-01, ruling out H-RESPONSE-PROCESS-GAP) and not primarily because of estimate substitution (only 41% of disputed bills are ESTIMATED, E-04). Tariff misapplication is ruled out as the specific actual-read error mechanism (0 tariff changes logged, E-05), leaving an unresolved billing-side defect (import validation rule change or meter value error) as the cause of wrong bills on actual reads.
